g.text: Plan stage: read rules and plan playbook, write plan.html
checklist.py init KEY: creates tasks.html (loop not armed yet)
loop.py start KEY: arms the loop for this session
Next open step: read its playbook, do the work
checklist.py block KEY STEP reason, or ask KEY question
tasks.html re-renders, browser shows the change within 20 s
Turn ends: Stop hook runs (see Stop guard chart)
Your next message: prompt hook adds the checklist
